info.title: API.SH: arXiv
info.description: The arXiv API from API.SH: public arXiv data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The papers an author has on arXiv: title, id and version, abstract, authors, published and updated dates, primary category and categories, comment, journal reference, DOI, and abstract, PDF and HTML links, with the total count. Newest first by default; sort by relevance, oldest or last updated, and narrow to one category. Paged.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arxiv-author

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Author name as written on papers, e.g. Yann LeCun.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only papers in this arXiv category, e.g. cs.LG, cs.CV, hep-th.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest (default), oldest, updated or relevance.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A category's announcement listing as arxiv.org shows it: list=new is the latest announcement (new submissions, cross-lists and replacements, with abstracts and comments); list=recent covers the last five announcement days. Each paper has id, title, authors, comments, journal reference, primary and other categories, and links. `limit` is rounded up to 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000 or 2000. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arxiv-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: arXiv category or archive (cs.AI, math.CO, hep-th, q-bio...).

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: new (latest announcement, default) or recent (last five days).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search arXiv preprints by text, category and author: id, version, title, abstract, authors (with affiliations when given), published and updated dates, primary and all categories, comment, journal reference, DOI and the abstract, PDF and HTML links. `q` also accepts arXiv field syntax (ti:, au:, abs:, cat: with AND/OR/ANDNOT). Target one field with `title`, `abstract`, `journal_ref` or `all`, and limit results to a submission date range with `date_from` / `date_to`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arxiv-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text, or arXiv field syntax such as ti:transformer AND au:vaswani. One of q, category, author, title, abstract, journal_ref or all is required.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: arXiv category, e.g. cs.CV, cs.LG, hep-th, math.AP.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Author name.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Words or a phrase that must appear in the title.

parameters.name: abstract
parameters.description: Words or a phrase that must appear in the abstract.

parameters.name: journal_ref
parameters.description: Words that must appear in the journal reference, e.g. a journal name.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Words or a phrase that must appear in any field.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Only papers submitted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Only papers submitted on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), newest, oldest or updated.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every version of a paper with its submission date and size, the submitter, comments, journal reference, DOI and licence.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/arxiv-versions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: arXiv id or abs/pdf link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
